ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the circuit diagram is an 8255 chip, and the chip select terminal of the chip is labeled as CS with an overline, that is, active-low /CS. The A1 and A0 pins of the 8255 are directly connected to the CPU address lines A1 and A0, and are used for internal register selection. On the left there are address lines labeled A7, A6, A5, A4, A3, and the IO/M control signal; these high-order address lines pass through a decoding gate with a small output inversion bubble and then connect to the /CS input of the 8255. Reasoning: When the output of this decoding gate is low level, the 8255 is selected, so when the decoded high-order address lines satisfy the condition of all being 1, /CS is valid. A1 and A0 only enter the 8255 for register selection; A2 is not decoded, so A2, A1, and A0 are all don't-care bits. Therefore the address template is A7 A6 A5 A4 A3 A2 A1 A0 = 11111xxx. Let xxx be the minimum 000, obtaining 11111000b = F8H; let xxx be the maximum 111, obtaining 11111111b = FFH. Therefore the address range in which the 8255 is selected is F8H to FFH.

method.method_draft: First inspect the diagram to identify which CPU address lines are decoded for /CS and which go directly into the 8255. Note that A1 and A0 are direct 8255 register-select inputs, while the decoder asserts the active-low chip select when the upper address pattern is all 1s; A2 is not decoded. Form the address template as A7 A6 A5 A4 A3 A2 A1 A0 = 11111xxx. Then enumerate the minimum and maximum values of the three don't-care bits: 11111000b = F8H and 11111111b = FFH. Report the selected address range as F8H–FFH.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路图右侧是 8255 芯片，芯片的片选端标为带横线的 CS，即低有效 /CS。8255 的 A1 和 A0 引脚直接接到 CPU 地址线 A1、A0，用作内部寄存器选择。左侧有地址线标注 A7、A6、A5、A4、A3，以及 IO/M 控制信号；这些高位地址线经一个带输出反相小圆点的译码门后接到 8255 的 /CS 输入。推理：该译码门输出为低电平时选中 8255，因此在被译码的高位地址线满足全为 1 的条件时，/CS 有效。A1、A0 只是进入 8255 作寄存器选择；A2 没有被译码，因此 A2、A1、A0 都是 don't-care 位。于是地址模板为 A7 A6 A5 A4 A3 A2 A1 A0 = 11111xxx。令 xxx 最小为 000，得到 11111000b = F8H；令 xxx 最大为 111，得到 11111111b = FFH。所以 8255 被选中的地址范围是 F8H 到 FFH。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit diagram: the 8255 block has active-low CS input, CPU address lines A1 and A0 connected to the 8255 A1 and A0 pins, and the chip-select line driven by a NAND-style decoder fed by the higher address lines shown at the left, effectively selecting when A7 through A3 are high for an I/O access; A2 is not used in the select logic.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question statement only to know the requested quantity: the address range for which the 8255 is selected.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use 8255 addressing convention: A1,A0 select the internal ports/control register, while /CS must be asserted low for the chip; undecoded address bits are don't-cares. Convert the fixed high bits A7..A3 = 11111 with A2,A1,A0 varying from 000 to 111 into hexadecimal addresses: 11111000b to 11111111b = F8H to FFH.
